from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single document from the collection, including its title and which other collection papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper, as named in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from the collection) that appear in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed data for the collection of papers."""
    papers: list[Paper]
